Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 24-Dec-2024 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.Tech. (CORE STREAM) DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2024 / JANUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: MIE 1071/MIE_1071 BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING  
  (MAKEUP/REGULAR)  
  BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING [MIE 1071]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                        Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Two boilers, one with super heater and another without super heater are delivering equal quantities (4)  
  of steam into a common main. The pressure in the boilers and in the main is 20 bar. The  
  temperature of the steam from a boiler with a superheater is 350°C and the temperature of steam  
  in the main is 250°C. Determine the quality of steam supplied by the other boiler. Assume specific  
  heat of superheated steam as 2.25 kJ/Kg K.  
1B)               A restaurant daily uses 600 kg of 95% dry steam produced at a pressure of 3 bar. The boiler is fitted (3)  
  with an economizer which increases the feed water temperature to 94° C and is fired using wood  
  and paddy husk in equal proportions. The gross calorific values of wood and paddy husk are 15500  
  kJ/kg and 12600 kJ/kg respectively. The boiler has been operating with an average efficiency of  
  78%. Calculate the daily consumption of wood and paddy husk?  
1C)               Justify the following statements through appropriate reasoning:                                            (3)  
  a) Water tube boilers are always preferred over fire tube boilers in thermal power plants.  
  b) Boiler accessories do not form the integral part of the boiler.  
  c) Babcock and Wilcox boiler have inclined water tubes.  
2A)               A belt drive transmitting power between two pulleys which are 2 meters apart with a speed                  (4)  
  reduction ratio of 4 has an angle of contact of 3.91 radians. The diameter of the larger pulley is 120  
  cm and the driver pulley runs at 1600 rpm. The initial tension in the belt is 0.95 kN and the  
  coefficient of friction is 0.28. Calculate the length of the belt, power transmitted and width of the belt  
  if the permissible tension per meter width of the belt is 10 kN.  
2B)               There are 5 wheels having 20, 30, 40, 50 and 70 teeth with a diametral pitch of 3 and another set of (3)  
  4 wheels of diametral pitch of 2 having 20, 40, 60 and 80 teeth. Sketch an arrangement to get  
  maximum velocity ratio using maximum number of wheels from the above lot. Also mention the  
  conditions used.  
2C)               Compare the performance of an open belt drive with a cross belt drive, providing six differences in        (3)  
  a tabulated form.  
3A)               An I.C. engine with a compression ratio of 16:1 runs with a camshaft speed of 500 rpm. Identify,           (4)  
  sketch and explain the working principle of the given engine.  
3B)               From a test on a four-stroke petrol engine, the following data is available: engine speed 1000 rpm,        (3)  
  net brake torque 70 Nm, indicative mean effective pressure 10 bar, stroke 150 mm, bore 100 mm,  
  rate of fuel consumption 2.57 kg/h, CV of petrol 41000 kJ/kg. Calculate the indicated thermal  
  efficiency, brake thermal efficiency and mechanical efficiency.  
3C)               Justify the following by providing appropriate reasons:                                                    (3)  
  i) Diesel engines are difficult to start in cold weather conditions.  
  ii) Two stroke engines require lighter flywheel  
  iii) Piston rings are an essential part of the piston

4A)   Suggest a suitable lathe operation to obtain short length and steep taper surface.              (4)  
4B)   Give reasons for the following:                                                                 (3)  
  i) Bench drilling machines are called as sensitive drilling machines.  
  ii) Guideways are machined on top of the lathe bed.  
  iii) The center attached to the headstock spindle is called as live center.  
4C)   Identify and explain the suitable welding process which is widely used in the body shop of an   (3)  
  automobile manufacturing unit.  
5A)   List down and explain green sand moulding properties.                                           (4)  
5B)   What are the benefits with implementation of Automation in manufacturing?                       (3)  
5C)   How robots are useful in following applications?                                                (3)  
  i) Welding  
  ii) Processing operations
